# Configuration Guides

> AI agents should consult [Docs for Agents](https://developer.pingidentity.com/build-with-ai/docs-for-agents.md)
> for guidance on navigating Ping Identity documentation.

## Configuration Guides

- [Assigning Amazon Managed Grafana administrators](https://docs.pingidentity.com/configuration_guides/amazon/config_saml_amazonmanagedgrafana_p1_assigning_administrators.md): Assign the Grafana Admin role to users via PingOne SAML assertion attribute mapping during authentication
- [Assigning Amazon Managed Grafana group access](https://docs.pingidentity.com/configuration_guides/amazon/config_saml_amazonmanagedgrafana_p1_assigning_group_access.md): Add PingOne user group access to Amazon Managed Grafana from the Group Access tab
- [Configuration Guide Overview](https://docs.pingidentity.com/configuration_guides/config_configuration_guides.md): SAML SSO configuration guide overview for PingFederate and PingOne integrations with business applications
- [Configure direct Salesforce sign on using PingOne (SP-initiated login) plus SLO](https://docs.pingidentity.com/configuration_guides/salesforce/config_signon_slo_salesforce_p1.md): Configure Salesforce SP-initiated sign-on and single logout (SLO) with PingOne — extends IdP-initiated setup
- [Configure direct Salesforce sign-on using PingFederate (SP-initiated sign-on) plus single logout (SLO)](https://docs.pingidentity.com/configuration_guides/salesforce/config_signon_slo_salesforce_pf.md): Configure Salesforce SP-initiated sign-on and single logout (SLO) with PingFederate — extends IdP-initiated setup
- [Configuring Amazon Managed Grafana SAML](https://docs.pingidentity.com/configuration_guides/amazon/config_saml_amazonmanagedgrafana_p1_configuring_saml.md): Configure Amazon Managed Grafana SAML settings using PingOne metadata or certificate
- [Configuring an Amazon Managed Grafana connection](https://docs.pingidentity.com/configuration_guides/amazon/config_saml_amazonmanagedgrafana_p1_configuring_connection.md): Set up an Amazon Managed Grafana application connection in PingOne from the Application Catalog
- [Configuring SAML SSO using DocuSign and PingFederate](https://docs.pingidentity.com/configuration_guides/docusign/config_saml_docusign_pf.md): Configure SAML SSO with DocuSign and PingFederate — IdP-initiated and SP-initiated sign-on
